title: Ichigo Mashimaro Episode 0
justification: AniList 4156 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2005-06-08, 4 min) is AniDB 2787's special S1 Prologue, aired 2005-06-08. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 488, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 2787, and the special's title is contained in AniList's synonym Strawberry Marshmallow Prologue / Ichigo Mashimaro Prologue (AniList's own title says Episode 0, the same prologue). The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 Prologue (2005-06-08) and on TMDB 35730 S0E1 Prologue (2005-06-08, 4 min).
